build_BaseFairseqModel_subclass: build a subclass of BaseFairseqModel to create a custom fairseq model with forward and loss methods
build_FairseqEncoderDecoderModel: build a FairseqEncoderDecoderModel by passing an encoder and decoder to the constructor for seq2seq tasks
build_FairseqLanguageModel: build a FairseqLanguageModel by passing a decoder to the constructor for decoder-only language modeling
build_FairseqEncoderModel: build a FairseqEncoderModel by passing an encoder to the constructor for encoder-only feature extraction
load_FairseqMultiModel: load a FairseqMultiModel with multiple encoder-decoder pairs for multi-task or multi-lingual training
